name: New Hampshire

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: Information Technology Accessibility Policy (NHS0305 v4, reported effective 2024-06-25)

applies_to: Executive branch agencies' internal and external IT solutions (per search summary of NHS0305); local governments via ADA Title II.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Universally accessible agency websites (e-Government 'universal access' principle)
Archived pre-2026-04-24 documents marked with an archive icon and accommodation contact
DoIT monthly accessibility scans for web platform sites (ARPA-funded through October 2026)
mobile: implied — DoIT page notes Title II covers websites, web apps and mobile applications; policy text not reviewed.
enforcement: Not verified beyond ADA Title II.
notes: nh.gov and doit.nh.gov returned 403; the policy PDF (NHS0305) could not be opened and has no archive copy, so its doc number, version, effective date and scope are from search summaries only. RSA 21-R:13 (sometimes cited) is about open data formats, not accessibility. No NH accessibility statute found.
